```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
source("../src/etl/suppression.R")

div <- yaml::read_yaml("divisions.yml")[[params$division]]
stopifnot(!is.null(div))
# Optional per-entry fields: department_pattern (filter use by department, for a unit that is not a college division),
# faculty, unit_word. Defaults keep the division briefs unchanged.
faculty   <- div$faculty   %||% paste(div$short, "faculty")
unit_word <- div$unit_word %||% "division"

# DSC activity records matched to a department, from the restricted person spine (2026-10-24 export).
# Aggregates only; cells under 5 are already blank or omitted at export. Not yet in the public claim register.
sp <- read_csv("spine-aggregates-2026-10-24.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
spd <- sp |> filter(division == params$division)
stopifnot(nrow(spd) > 0)
spk <- spd |> filter(row_type == "kind")
spu <- spd |> filter(row_type == "unit") |> arrange(desc(events))
cov <- sp |> filter(row_type == "coverage")
cov_total <- cov$events[cov$item == "ucla_email_events_total"]
cov_unit  <- cov$events[cov$item == "ucla_email_events_with_unit"]
kv  <- function(kind, col) spk[[col]][spk$item == kind]
n_events <- function(kind) { v <- kv(kind, "events"); if (length(v) == 0 || is.na(v)) "fewer than 5" else scales::comma(v) }
n_people <- function(kind) { v <- kv(kind, "people"); if (length(v) == 0 || is.na(v)) "fewer than 5" else as.character(v) }
yrs <- function(kind) { a <- kv(kind, "first_year"); b <- kv(kind, "last_year"); if (a == b) a else paste(a, "to", b) }
unit_rows <- spu |> transmute(Department = item, Records = events)
other_n <- sum(spk$events, na.rm = TRUE) - sum(spu$events)
if (other_n >= 5) unit_rows <- bind_rows(unit_rows, tibble(Department = "Other departments (each fewer than 5)", Records = other_n))

# Staff capacity (claim #17 and the home page)
cap <- read_csv("../data/processed/canonical/service_capacity_by_year.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  mutate(fte = dsc_staff_fte + contributed_staff_fte) |> filter(!is.na(fte))
fte_peak <- sprintf("%.1f", max(cap$fte))
fte_now  <- sprintf("%.1f", cap$fte[which.max(cap$year)])
# Doug's wording: "about 30%", not FTE numbers. Rounded to the nearest 5 percent.
fte_drop <- round(100 * (1 - cap$fte[which.max(cap$year)] / max(cap$fte)) / 5) * 5

hl <- read_csv("../data/processed/canonical/headline_aggregates.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
h  <- function(k) hl |> filter(metric_id == k) |> pull(display) |> first()
mon <- function(d) format(as.Date(d), "%b %Y")
at_least <- function(n) if (n < 5) "fewer than 5" else paste("at least", comma(n))
comma <- scales::comma
```

The Data Science Center (DSC) was the UCLA Library team that `r div$team_line %||% "supported research data, 3D scanning, and data consulting"`. On August 24, 2026 the Library dissolved it and moved its staff into Research Services. This brief covers research in `r div$noun` that DSC has worked on and what would help `r faculty`. The research belongs to the faculty and students named; DSC's part is stated each time.

::: {.in-brief}

## In brief

- **What DSC did:** `r div$did %||% "3D scanning, text recognition, and data hosting"` for research in `r div$noun`, in the projects below.
- **Capacity and service changes:** DSC's staff capacity fell by about `r fte_drop`% between 2022-23 and 2025-26. `r div$changes_line %||% "The Library has announced that drone lending ends this fall and that DataSquad stops running as a coordinated program."`
- **What we ask:** `r div$ask_short %||% "that you ask Library leadership for four things: the reasons the Center was retired and a written plan for this research, a named person accountable for each service, enough capacity to keep supporting it, and a check-in schedule."`

:::

```{r extra-sections, results='asis'}
# Optional division sections (e.g. memberships, geospatial), rendered before "What would help".
for (sec in div$extra_sections %||% list()) {
  cat("## ", sec$heading, "\n\n", sec$body, "\n\n", sep = "")
}
```

## What would help

```{r asks, results='asis'}
# Optional division override of the asks; default is the original four (Humanities, Cotsen).
if (!is.null(div$asks)) {
  cat(div$asks_lead, "\n\n", sep = "")
  for (i in seq_along(div$asks)) cat(i, ". ", div$asks[[i]], "\n", sep = "")
  cat("\n")
} else {
  cat("This work still needs someone when a unit changes shape. **Who will maintain access, technical support, and stewardship for these functions in ", div$noun, ", and with what capacity?** We would like four things:\n\n", sep = "")
  cat("1. The reasons the Center was retired, and the written plan for the research it supported.\n")
  cat("2. Who is accountable, by role, for the 3D, data, and repository services that ", faculty, " rely on, which of them continue today, and who to call.", div$briefing_extra %||% "", "\n", sep = "")
  cat("3. Enough capacity to keep supporting this research, given the staff drop and service endings listed above.\n")
  cat("4. A check-in at 12 and 24 months after the August 2026 reorganization on which services continue, who staffs them, and whether researchers can still get help, with faculty taking part.\n\n")
}
```

## Research we have worked on

```{r examples, results='asis'}
for (ex in div$examples) {
  cat("::: {.research-entry}\n\n### ", ex$title, "\n\n", ex$text, "\n\n", sep = "")
  cat("**DSC's part:** ", ex$supplied, ".", sep = "")
  if (!is.null(ex$link)) cat(" [", ex$link_text %||% "Source", "](", ex$link, ")", sep = "")
  if (!is.null(ex$link2)) cat(" [", ex$link2_text %||% "Source", "](", ex$link2, ")", sep = "")
  cat("\n\n:::\n\n")
}
```

::: {.evidence}

## Evidence

### Documented use by the `r unit_word`

Counts come from DSC's workshop and consultation records for UCLA people, limited to records where the self-reported department or field of study is known and maps to the `r unit_word`. Of `r scales::comma(cov_total)` records campus-wide with a UCLA email address, `r scales::comma(cov_unit)` (about `r round(100*cov_unit/cov_total)`%) matched any department, so these are floors, not the `r unit_word`'s full use. Departments under 5 records are combined into one row or omitted; the totals below include them.`r if (!is.null(div$mapping_note)) paste0(" ", div$mapping_note) else ""`

- **Consultations:** `r n_events("consult")` consultation records from `r n_people("consult")` people in `r div$short` departments, `r yrs("consult")`.
- **Workshops:** `r n_events("attendance")` attendance records from `r n_people("attendance")` people, `r yrs("attendance")`. Most workshop registration forms after 2021 did not ask for a department, so later attendance often cannot be matched; the fall 2025 series asked for a field of study, which we treat as a department-level self-report`r if (params$division == "humanities") " (it appears here as 'Humanities' in the table)" else ""`.
`r if (!is.null(div$topics)) paste0("- **What they came for:** ", div$topics)`
`r if (!is.null(div$research_data)) paste0("- **Research data:** ", div$research_data)`
`r if (!is.null(div$teaching)) paste0("- **Teaching:** ", div$teaching)`

```{r depts}
knitr::kable(unit_rows, col.names = c("Department (consultations and workshop attendance)", "Records"),
             format.args = list(big.mark = ","))
```
